newsitem.title: THAILAND: Phatra Thanakit to separate businesses.
newsitem.headline: Phatra Thanakit to separate businesses.

text.p: Major Thai finance and securities firm Phatra Thanakit Plc said on Thursday it would separate its finance and securities operations.

In a statement to the Stock Exchange of Thailand the firm said it would form a new securities firm, in which Phatra would hold a minimum 99 percent stake, and its current securities operations would be transferred to that unit.
The central bank permits Thai finance and securities companies which split their operations to engage in a wider range of activities.
